> > It's quite appropriate you used quotes for obviously because...
> 
> You "obvioulsy" missed the point. You did not provide sufficient information for anyone else to duplicate the problem, but waved it under the "obvioulsy" banner.
> 
> As far as this issue is concerned, there is no discernible problem with ART itself or the AUR packages. GNOME and nautilus are also most likely okay. The problem is probably related to how you're creating the custom shortcut, but no one without physical access to your machine would be able to tell because you didn't provide details.

Perhaps, fair enough.

The way I'm creating my custom shortcut is as follows: Open up **Settings**, navigate to **Keyboard**, choose **View and Customise Shortcuts**, select **Launchers**, click **Home folder**, press **Super** and **E** at the same time, then click the blue **Set** button.

If there are any other details I can provide, I'm happy to do so.
